purpose: Reusable integration-axis and generalized legal-build registry for mixed-TL validation. It is not an evidence log and does not automatically promote gameplay values.

pairingPolicy.note: Candidate/control variants should share random streams whenever the changed dimension permits a clean paired comparison.

activationPolicy: Activate the smallest dependency-relevant submatrix that answers the causal question, then carry locally validated candidates into broader mixed-TL integration.
A shared sensitivity axis does not imply symmetric promotion across subsystem families.
Include mixed-TL, high-power-demand, and unusual-but-legal construction contexts when the changed dependency can interact with them.
Use actual-consumer preflight plus one-trial smoke before substantive Monte Carlo for any new or materially changed integrated study.
Audit dispatch, pre-run validation, shared/global gate classifications, study-specific gates, report routing, schema/baseline bindings, checkpoint stages, and study-family helpers before handoff.
Keep outcome/balance targets review-only unless a deterministic invariant is genuinely being promoted.
Construction legality follows actual Installation Space/prerequisite/compatibility rules; simultaneous Tactical Power insufficiency is an operational tradeoff, not an automatic invalid-build filter.
Generated broad-permutation studies must pass deterministic generator validation, actual-consumer preflight, and one-trial full-pipeline smoke before substantive screening.
Every legal combat build must include at least one Main Weapon and at least one Reactor; optional explicit duplication remains legal when actual construction constraints permit it.
Generated doctrine must price rated systems at their actual effective Tactical Power cost before optional activation decisions.

Dynamic movement/range doctrine must preserve attack eligibility. Broad legal-build fixed references may legitimately be track-denied or strategically weak, but zero-attack lanes caused overwhelmingly by self-inflicted Tactical Power starvation are release failures.

Generalized enumeration may include optional absence of non-core systems and explicit component duplication; never prune a legal build merely because it appears strategically weak or power-constrained.
Redundant same-type ECM/ECCM installations are physically distinct for damage/redundancy but resolve to the highest applicable functional rating rather than additive strength.
Bounded screens should stratify by progression distance and build composition so cross-TL cliffs and odd legal combinations are not hidden by named recipes alone.

currentCoverage.currentExpansion: Generalize the 35-Space envelope to optional active Sensor/Shield/PDS/EW, explicit one-or-two homogeneous Main Weapon/Reactor choices, and redundant non-additive ECM/ECCM; execute 48 named pairings plus a 96-pair deterministic progression/composition-stratified sample across three geometries.
currentCoverage.combatActivityGuard: Fixed references may legitimately be unable to attack because of legal construction or enemy track denial; release gating rejects pure self-inflicted power-doctrine zero-attack deadlocks, and dynamic contexts preserve attack types materially active in the fixed reference.
currentCoverage.powerAwareDoctrine: Use preserve-combat-package EW doctrine with actual rating-scaled ECM/ECCM costs.
currentCoverage.crossTlDirection: Continue broadening legal-build axes and pairing coverage across multiple TLs; enumerate all legal builds, screen bounded deterministic samples, and escalate only diagnostically important regions.
